item.title: [翻译] TLDR AI: OpenAI百元新套餐、Claude企业版上线、Perplexity携手Plaid
item.description:
标签: #AI产品 #商业化 #智能体 #多模态

摘要: OpenAI推出每月100美元的ChatGPT Pro新套餐以完善定价策略，Claude Cowork企业版正式上线并提供组织管控与扩展观察功能，同时Perplexity通过与Plaid整合将服务从投资组合追踪扩展为全方位个人财务中心。

原标题: OpenAI $100 plan 💳, Claude Cowork GA 🏢, Perplexity x Plaid 💸

TLDR AI 2026-04-10

TLDR AI 2026-04-10

OpenAI $100 plan 💳, Claude Cowork GA 🏢, Perplexity x Plaid 💸

OpenAI 百元计划 💳，Claude Cowork 全面上市 🏢，Perplexity 携手 Plaid 💸

Aman Sanger, Cursor: “After switching to turbopuffer, we're saving an order of magnitude in costs” (Sponsor)

turbopuffer is the vector database for search. It's built on object storage with smart caching - so it's fast, cheap, and extremely scalable.

  • ✅ Used by Cursor, Notion, Linear, Cognition, Atlassian, Ramp, Granola, Legora...
  • ✅ Fast → ~20ms p90 latency on 10M documents
  • ✅ Truly serverless → Run your first query in ~4 minutes
  • ✅ Up to 95% cheaper than traditional vector/text search databases

TLDR readers get their first month free. Sign up here.

Aman Sanger，Cursor："在切换到 turbopuffer 后，我们的成本节省了一个数量级"（赞助商）

turbopuffer 是专为搜索设计的 向量数据库（vector database）。它基于对象存储构建，具备智能缓存功能——因此速度快、成本低且极具可扩展性。

  • ✅ 已被 Cursor、Notion、Linear、Cognition、Atlassian、Ramp、Granola、Legora 等公司使用……
  • ✅ 速度快 → 1000 万文档的 P90 延迟约 20 毫秒
  • ✅ 真正的无服务器架构 → 约 4 分钟即可运行首个查询
  • ✅ 比传统 向量/文本搜索数据库 便宜高达 95%

TLDR 读者可享受首月免费。点击此处注册。

ChatGPT $100 Pro Plan Introduced (2 minute read)

OpenAI introduced a new $100/month ChatGPT Pro tier aimed at power users, expanding its pricing lineup between the $20 Plus and $200 Pro plans. The company confirmed the $200 plan still exists despite not being listed on the pricing page.

ChatGPT 推出 100 美元 Pro 套餐（2 分钟阅读）

OpenAI 推出了新的每月 100 美元 ChatGPT Pro 层级，面向重度用户，在 20 美元的 Plus 套餐和 200 美元的 Pro 套餐之间扩展了其定价阵容。该公司确认，尽管定价页面上未列出，但 200 美元的套餐仍然存在。

Making Claude Cowork ready for enterprise (3 minute read)

Claude Cowork is now enterprise-ready, enhancing work with organization controls like role-based access, group spend limits, and expanded observability features. Admins can manage adoption with detailed usage analytics and integrate tools like Zoom for seamless workflows. Companies like Zapier and Airtree have already leveraged these features for improved project management and operational efficiency.

让 Claude Cowork 为企业级应用做好准备（3 分钟阅读）

Claude Cowork 现已具备企业级就绪能力，通过组织控制功能（如基于角色的访问控制（role-based access）、群组消费限额和扩展的可观测性（observability）功能）增强工作体验。管理员可以通过详细的使用分析来管理采用情况，并集成 Zoom 等工具以实现无缝工作流。Zapier 和 Airtree 等公司已经利用这些功能改进了项目管理和运营效率。

Perplexity launches Personal Finance powered by Plaid (2 minute read)

Perplexity has expanded its financial services with Plaid integration, transitioning from portfolio tracking to a comprehensive finance dashboard. Users can link checking, savings, credit card, and loan accounts to analyze spending, track liabilities, and calculate net worth. Targeted at AI-savvy consumers, it combines data insights with Plaid's infrastructure, transforming from a portfolio add-on to a full personal finance hub without executing trades.

Perplexity 推出由 Plaid 支持的个人金融服务（2 分钟阅读）

Perplexity 通过与 Plaid 的集成扩展了其金融服务，从投资组合追踪（portfolio tracking）转型为综合金融仪表盘。用户可以关联支票账户、储蓄账户、信用卡和贷款账户，以分析支出、追踪负债并计算净资产。该产品面向精通 AI 的消费者，将数据洞察与 Plaid 的基础设施相结合，从一个投资组合附加功能转变为完整的个人金融中心，且无需执行实际交易。

Alibaba Claims Viral Happy Horse AI Model in Latest Breakthrough (3 minute read)

The Happy Horse video AI model that sent ripples across China's AI industry this week was created by Alibaba. The model hit the top spot on the text-to-video leaderboard of Artificial Analysis this week. Alibaba plans to provide API access to the model in the near future.

阿里巴巴（Alibaba）声称爆红的"欢乐马"AI 模型是其最新突破（3 分钟阅读）

本周在中国 AI 行业引起轰动的 Happy Horse 视频 AI 模型由 阿里巴巴 创建。该模型本周在 Artificial Analysis 的文本生成视频（text-to-video）排行榜上位居榜首。阿里巴巴计划近期为该模型提供 API 访问（API access）。

Agentic Infrastructure on Vercel (8 minute read)

Vercel argued that coding agents were reshaping how software gets built and deployed, with agent-initiated deployments rising sharply and accounting for more than 30% of weekly deployments. The post framed this shift as a need for new infrastructure designed for agents to deploy software, run AI systems, and increasingly operate infrastructure autonomously.

Vercel 上的 智能体基础设施（Agentic Infrastructure）（8 分钟阅读）

Vercel 认为，编程智能体正在重塑软件的构建和部署方式，智能体发起的部署（agent-initiated deployments）急剧增加，占每周部署量的 30% 以上。这篇文章将这一转变描述为对新型基础设施的需求，这种基础设施专为智能体部署软件、运行 AI 系统以及日益自主地操作基础设施而设计。

CoreWeave Takes As Much Financial Engineering As It Does Datacenter Design (4 minute read)

CoreWeave's revenue backlog is up to $87.8 billion, with Meta represents 40.1% of that backlog. OpenAI's deals represent 25.5% of extended backlog. CoreWeave only has two dozen named customers, but it likely has more. The company achieved $5.13 billion in sales in 2025, up 2.7x from 2024, and posted a net loss of $1.17 billion. It recently held a private offering of $1.75 billion in notes to cover its data center expansion costs.

CoreWeave 的金融工程与其数据中心设计同等复杂（4 分钟阅读）

CoreWeave 的收入积压订单（revenue backlog）高达 878 亿美元，其中 Meta 占 40.1%，OpenAI 的交易占扩展积压订单的 25.5%。CoreWeave 仅有二十几家知名客户，但很可能拥有更多客户。该公司 2025 年销售额达 51.3 亿美元，较 2024 年增长 2.7 倍，净亏损 11.7 亿美元。它最近进行了 17.5 亿美元的私募债券发行，以支付其数据中心扩张成本。

Research-Driven Agents: What Happens When Your Agent Reads Before It Codes (16 minute read)

Coding agents generate better optimizations when they read papers and study competing projects before touching code. Coding agents working from code alone generate shallow hypotheses. Adding a research phase improves results.

👨‍💻

研究驱动型智能体：当智能体在编码前先阅读会发生什么（16 分钟阅读）

当编程智能体在接触代码之前先阅读论文并研究竞争项目时，它们会产生更好的优化方案。仅基于代码工作的编程智能体会产生浅层假设。增加研究阶段可以改善结果。

👨‍💻

Engineering & Research

工程与研究

IronClaw: the secure agent harness for always-on AI (Sponsor)

You're one API key away from an agent that codes, commits, and pulls from GitHub and Slack autonomously. What's stopped you is trusting it with credentials.

IronClaw isolates every tool in a Wasm sandbox. Credentials never reach the model.

Open-source, built in rust, deployable on NEAR AI Cloud. Verifiably yours.

Try IronClaw Free →

IronClaw：面向永不停歇 AI 的安全智能体框架（赞助商）

只需一个 API 密钥（API key），你就能拥有一个可以自主编码、提交代码并从 GitHub 和 Slack 拉取信息的智能体。阻碍你的是对其凭证安全的信任问题。

IronClaw 将每个工具隔离在 Wasm 沙盒（Wasm sandbox）中。凭证永远不会到达模型。

开源，使用 Rust 构建，可部署在 NEAR AI Cloud 上。真正属于你。

免费试用 IronClaw →

Process Driven Image Generation (22 minute read)

Meta has introduced a multi-step framework for image synthesis that alternates between textual reasoning and visual updates. This enables models to iteratively plan, draft, reflect, and refine outputs.

流程驱动的图像生成（22 分钟阅读）

Meta 引入了一个多步骤图像合成框架，在文本推理和视觉更新之间交替进行。这使模型能够迭代地规划、起草、反思和优化输出。

Multimodal Embedding & Reranker Models with Sentence Transformers (8 minute read)

The v5.4 update of Sentence Transformers introduces multimodal embedding and reranker models that enable encoding and comparing texts, images, audio, and videos within a shared embedding space for tasks like cross-modal search and retrieval-augmented generation. These advanced models map different modalities into a consistent embedding space and assess relevance across mixed-modality pairs, though lower cross-modal similarity scores may occur due to modality clustering. Notably, multimodal rerankers provide high-quality scoring by evaluating individual pairs for more accurate retrieval results.

使用 Sentence Transformers 的 多模态嵌入（Multimodal Embedding）与重排序模型（Reranker Models）（8 分钟阅读）

Sentence Transformers 的 v5.4 更新引入了多模态嵌入和重排序模型，能够在共享嵌入空间内对文本、图像、音频和视频进行编码和比较，用于跨模态搜索和检索增强生成（retrieval-augmented generation, RAG）等任务。这些高级模型将不同模态映射到一致的嵌入空间，并评估混合模态对之间的相关性，尽管由于模态聚类可能导致跨模态相似性分数较低。值得注意的是，多模态重排序器通过评估单个配对来提供高质量的评分，从而获得更准确的检索结果。

Anthropic launches advisor tool for Claude Platform API users (1 minute read)

The new advisor tool on Anthropic's Claude Platform API provides developers with the ability to use Opus as an advisor alongside Sonnet or Haiku as executors. This allows agents to access advanced reasoning capabilities while maintaining operational costs at the level of the more efficient executor models. The advisor tool is now publicly available through a configuration in the Messages API request.

Anthropic 为 Claude Platform API 用户推出顾问工具（1 分钟阅读）

Anthropic 的 Claude Platform API 上的新顾问工具使开发者能够将 Opus 用作顾问，同时将 Sonnet 或 Haiku 用作执行器。这允许智能体在保持更高效执行器模型水平的运营成本的同时，访问高级推理能力。该顾问工具现已通过 Messages API 请求中的配置公开可用。

Efficient Rollout Scaling for Diffusion RL (4 minute read)

NVIDIA's Sol-RL introduces a two-stage framework that separates exploration and training, using FP4 rollouts to generate large candidate sets and BF16 for selective policy updates. This approach reduced compute costs while improving alignment and accelerating convergence in diffusion model post-training.

扩散强化学习（Diffusion RL）的高效 rollout 扩展（4 分钟阅读）

NVIDIA 的 Sol-RL 引入了一个两阶段框架，将探索与训练分离，使用 FP4 rollout 生成大型候选集，并使用 BF16 进行选择性策略更新。这种方法在降低计算成本的同时，提高了对齐度并加速了扩散模型（diffusion model）后训练的收敛速度。

Introducing KellyBench (2 minute read)

KellyBench evaluates sequential decision-making in sports betting by simulating the 2023-24 English Premier League season. Models like Claude Opus 4.6 and GPT-5.4 struggled, with none achieving positive returns, highlighting their limitations in adapting to long-term strategies. This underscores a need for complex environments enabling agents to learn from experience under uncertainty.

推出 KellyBench（2 分钟阅读）

KellyBench 通过模拟 2023-24 赛季英格兰足球超级联赛来评估体育博彩中的顺序决策。Claude Opus 4.6 和 GPT-5.4 等模型表现挣扎，没有一个实现正收益，凸显了它们在适应长期策略方面的局限性。这强调了需要复杂环境来使智能体能够在不确定性下从经验中学习。

Dario Says Continual Learning Is Solved. Is It? (5 minute read)

Continual learning research is aimed at breaking past the feasible horizon of current techniques. If models can't learn new things while performing tasks, they will struggle when the task horizon grows very long. Context management and other engineering improvements can push task horizons to weeks, or even months, but very long-horizon tasks remain out of reach. Human-level continual learning may be 'solved', but the revolution is not yet complete.

Dario（Amodei）称持续学习（Continual Learning）已解决。真的吗？（5 分钟阅读）

持续学习研究旨在突破当前技术的可行范围。如果模型无法在执行任务的同时学习新事物，当任务时间范围变得很长时，它们将难以应对。上下文管理（Context management）和其他工程改进可以将任务时间范围延长到数周甚至数月，但超长期任务仍然遥不可及。人类水平的持续学习或许已经"解决"，但革命尚未完成。

item.title: [翻译] Simon Willison: ChatGPT语音模式其实是个弱模型
item.description:
标签: #语音模式 #模型能力 #产品差异

摘要: 文章指出ChatGPT语音模式实际基于较旧的GPT-4o模型（知识截止2024年4月），与OpenAI最先进的编程模型存在显著能力差距；作者引用Andrej Karpathy的观点解释，这种差异源于编程任务拥有可验证的奖励机制且商业价值更高，因而获得更集中的研发优化。

原标题: ChatGPT voice mode is a weaker model

ChatGPT Voice Mode Is a Weaker Model
ChatGPT 语音模式是一个较弱的模型

I think it's non-obvious to many people that the OpenAI voice mode runs on a much older, much weaker model - it feels like the AI that you can talk to should be the smartest AI but it really isn't.

我认为很多人并不清楚，OpenAI 的语音模式（voice mode）运行在一个更旧、更弱的模型上——感觉上你能与之对话的 AI 应该是最智能的 AI，但实际上并非如此。

If you ask ChatGPT voice mode for its knowledge cutoff date it tells you April 2024 - it's a GPT-4o era model.

如果你询问 ChatGPT 语音模式的知识截止日期（knowledge cutoff date），它会告诉你是 2024 年 4 月——这是一个 GPT-4o 时代的模型。

This thought inspired bythis Andrej Karpathy tweetabout the growing gap in understanding of AI capability based on the access points and domains people are using the models with:

这一想法灵感来自 Andrej Karpathy 的一条推文，关于人们对 AI 能力理解的差距正在扩大，这种差距基于人们使用模型的接入点（access points）和领域（domains）：

[...] It really is simultaneously the case that OpenAI's free and I think slightly orphaned (?) "Advanced Voice Mode" will fumble the dumbest questions in your Instagram's reels andat the same time, OpenAI's highest-tier and paid Codex model will go off for 1 hour to coherently restructure an entire code base, or find and exploit vulnerabilities in computer systems.This part really works and has made dramatic strides because 2 properties:these domains offer explicit reward functions that are verifiable meaning they are easily amenable to reinforcement learning training (e.g. unit tests passed yes or no, in contrast to writing, which is much harder to explicitly judge), but alsothey are a lot more valuable in b2b settings, meaning that the biggest fraction of the team is focused on improving them.
[...] 事实确实如此：一方面，OpenAI 免费的、我认为略显被忽视（orphaned？）的"高级语音模式（Advanced Voice Mode）"会在你的 Instagram 短视频连最简单的问题都回答不好；另一方面，OpenAI 最高层级、付费的 Codex 模型却可以花费 1 小时时间，连贯地重构整个代码库，或发现并利用计算机系统中的漏洞。这部分功能确实有效，并取得了显著进展，原因有二：这些领域提供了可验证的明确奖励函数（reward functions），意味着它们很容易适用于强化学习（reinforcement learning）训练（例如单元测试是否通过，这与写作不同，后者很难被明确评判）；同时，它们在 B2B 环境中更有价值，意味着团队的大部分精力都集中在改进这些方面。
[...] It really is simultaneously the case that OpenAI's free and I think slightly orphaned (?) "Advanced Voice Mode" will fumble the dumbest questions in your Instagram's reels andat the same time, OpenAI's highest-tier and paid Codex model will go off for 1 hour to coherently restructure an entire code base, or find and exploit vulnerabilities in computer systems.
[...] 事实确实如此：一方面，OpenAI 免费的、我认为略显被忽视的"高级语音模式"会在你的 Instagram 短视频连最简单的问题都回答不好；另一方面，OpenAI 最高层级、付费的 Codex 模型却可以花费 1 小时时间，连贯地重构整个代码库，或发现并利用计算机系统中的漏洞。
This part really works and has made dramatic strides because 2 properties:
这部分功能确实有效，并取得了显著进展，原因有二：
  • these domains offer explicit reward functions that are verifiable meaning they are easily amenable to reinforcement learning training (e.g. unit tests passed yes or no, in contrast to writing, which is much harder to explicitly judge), but also
  • they are a lot more valuable in b2b settings, meaning that the biggest fraction of the team is focused on improving them.
  • 这些领域提供了可验证的明确奖励函数（reward functions），意味着它们很容易适用于强化学习（reinforcement learning）训练（例如单元测试是否通过，这与写作不同，后者很难被明确评判）；并且
  • 它们在 B2B 环境中更有价值，意味着团队的大部分精力都集中在改进这些方面。
